name: CodeCraft Studio
about: CodeCraft Studio is a modern full-stack agency specializing in crafting high-quality web and mobile applications. Our team focuses on seamless user experiences, clean code, and scalable systems. We collaborate with startups and enterprises to design, build, and maintain products that make a real impact. From UI/UX to backend architecture and cloud integration, we ensure every project is performance-driven and user-focused. Our philosophy combines creativity, innovation, and engineering precision — transforming ideas into powerful digital solutions that grow businesses worldwide.

jobs.name: Senior React Developer
jobs.about: As a Senior React Developer at CodeCraft Studio, you’ll be responsible for building interactive, high-performance web applications. You’ll lead component architecture, handle complex state management, and integrate APIs using GraphQL or REST. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of React, TypeScript, modern build tools, and testing frameworks. You’ll work with designers and backend engineers to bring smooth, consistent experiences to users across platforms.

jobs.name: Node.js Backend Engineer
jobs.about: We are looking for a skilled Node.js engineer to develop and maintain scalable backend systems. You’ll build microservices, manage APIs, and work closely with DevOps for CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Express, MongoDB, and authentication systems is required. If you enjoy working with modern stacks and real-time data, you’ll love this role.

jobs.name: UI/UX Designer
jobs.about: As a UI/UX Designer, you’ll work closely with clients and developers to design modern, user-friendly interfaces. You’ll handle wireframes, prototypes, and design systems in Figma. Your focus will be on usability, accessibility, and ensuring that every pixel adds value to the experience. Knowledge of responsive design and interaction principles is a must.

name: PixelForge Labs
about: PixelForge Labs is a creative technology studio that blends design, storytelling, and advanced engineering. We build AR/VR experiences, animated product demos, and high-impact digital campaigns. Our work combines artistic precision and cutting-edge code to deliver stunning interactive products. Every project is backed by research, collaboration, and rapid iteration — ensuring pixel-perfect creativity that moves brands forward.

jobs.name: 3D Motion Designer
jobs.about: We’re hiring a 3D Motion Designer with strong skills in Blender, Cinema 4D, or Unreal Engine. You’ll produce high-quality animations for product marketing, AR/VR projects, and UI motion systems. You’ll collaborate with art directors and engineers to deliver visual experiences that are both artistic and functional.

jobs.name: Full Stack Developer
jobs.about: As a Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build immersive web applications with React, Node.js, and WebGL integrations. Experience with Next.js, APIs, and responsive UI design is required. You’ll work closely with artists to translate creative concepts into performant code.

jobs.name: Creative Project Manager
jobs.about: We’re looking for a Creative Project Manager who can bridge the gap between clients and the production team. You’ll manage project timelines, budgets, and ensure that creative assets are delivered to perfection. Prior experience in design or tech studios preferred.

name: CloudLink Systems
about: CloudLink Systems is a cloud consulting and infrastructure automation company that builds serverless solutions for data-heavy businesses. We design secure, scalable, and reliable platforms using AWS, GCP, and Azure. Our DevOps-first approach helps teams deploy faster and stay confident in production.

jobs.name: DevOps Engineer
jobs.about: We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to automate and manage CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments. You’ll work with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services to keep production stable and secure.

jobs.name: Cloud Security Analyst
jobs.about: As a Cloud Security Analyst, you’ll ensure compliance and protect sensitive systems across multiple clouds. You’ll define security policies, manage encryption, and monitor threats using automated tools.

name: Lumina AI
about: Lumina AI is an artificial intelligence startup that helps businesses harness the power of data. We develop custom machine learning models, AI chatbots, and automation tools to streamline workflows. Our mission is to make AI accessible, ethical, and impactful for companies of all sizes.

jobs.name: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.about: You’ll develop ML pipelines for NLP, vision, and predictive analytics projects. We prefer candidates familiar with Python, TensorFlow, and data engineering tools. You’ll collaborate with data scientists and backend developers.

jobs.name: Data Analyst
jobs.about: We’re hiring a Data Analyst to visualize and interpret business data. You’ll use SQL, Power BI, or Tableau to turn datasets into insights and assist in data-driven decision-making.

name: Marketly Digital
about: Marketly Digital is a performance marketing agency helping eCommerce brands scale profitably through SEO, paid media, and content strategy. We use data-driven tactics and creative storytelling to maximize ROI across all digital channels.

jobs.name: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.about: Responsible for managing SEO, Google Ads, and social media campaigns. You’ll analyze performance, optimize landing pages, and report KPIs.

jobs.name: Content Writer
jobs.about: We need a creative content writer to craft blogs, social captions, and brand stories that engage audiences and boost visibility.

name: FreelancrHub
about: FreelancrHub is a modern freelancing platform built for the new generation of remote professionals. We connect skilled freelancers with startups and enterprises worldwide. Our mission is to make freelancing efficient, transparent, and rewarding.

jobs.name: Frontend Freelancer
jobs.about: Work with clients worldwide on freelance front-end projects. Must know React, Tailwind CSS, and Git. Flexible schedule and remote-first culture.

jobs.name: WordPress Expert
jobs.about: Experienced WordPress developer needed to customize themes, build plugins, and maintain client websites. Prior freelancing experience preferred.
